body.p: , after , , , , . and found XQuery's lowering parts (about 75 KB) and evaluator_stream (14.5 KB) in the core sxml.wasm only because each part registry was one table: the lowerer's default was the whole lowering registry, sxml_function_library_parts_for_language was one switch over every language's list, and the evaluator looked up kinds in every evaluator part. A module could not leave out the parts of a language it does not offer.

item.p: One mechanism, three registries: cmake/SxmlParts.cmake writes, beside each registry's unit with every part, one translation unit per language (<registry>_<language>.c in generated/) holding the parts that serve it, and a function giving a pointer to that static list: sxml_function_library_<language>_parts() (src/function_library_parts_internal.h), sxml_xpath_lowering_<language>_parts() (src/xpath_lower_internal.h) and sxml_evaluator_<language>_parts() (src/evaluator_machine_internal.h), for xpath, xquery and xslt (glossary ). Naming one list links only its parts, so linking follows the languages a module's entry points offer, with no option and no #if.

Languages come from the declarations the parts already have: a library part's sxml_function_library_<part>_languages (); a lowering part's .languages field, which CMake now reads too (a part without one fails the configure; tests/part_registry_test.c checks that CMake read what the field says); an evaluator part's optional const sxml_language_set sxml_evaluator_part_<part>_languages, in the library parts' form (all three languages when absent). The registered entries of the lowering and evaluator registries carry the languages read.

Who names a list: the language's entry point. Library: the processor (XPath's, which XQuery uses too), XSLT compilation (XSLT's). Lowering: sxml_xpath_lower XPath's, XQuery's prolog XQuery's, XSLT's lowering XSLT's; a lowerer configured with parts.parts == NULL gets XPath's (it was the whole registry).

The evaluator: the unit carries its language's list (sxml_ir_unit_configuration.evaluator_parts, a const struct sxml_evaluator_registered_part_view *, set where sxml_xpath_lower, XQuery's prolog and XSLT's lowering create their units; NULL means XPath's), and sxml_machine_start_part_kind looks the kind up among the parts of the unit whose code runs (sxml_evaluator_find_kind_handler(parts, kind)), so an XSLT unit run from XPath (fn:transform) or an XPath unit inside XSLT (xsl:evaluate) finds its own parts. A unit built by hand (unit tests) names a list itself.
sxml_*_registered_parts() and sxml_function_library_parts_for_language stay, for tests and checks only: they link every part.

XQuery and XSLT parts: XQuery has no library or evaluator part of its own; its lowering parts are xquery, update and full_text (construct serves every language: XPath 4.0's computed constructors). XSLT's are the library parts xslt, exslt and output and the evaluator parts template (APPLY_TEMPLATES) and stream (STREAM). XSLT's instructions lower through procedures its own code pushes (), not registered parts.

Sizes (stripped / gzipped, wasm preset, at 5385a0e): sxml.wasm 2,215,004 / 774,905 (over 's 2,200,000 / 770,000 after 's IR passes: ir_loop_passes +15,375, evaluator_index +9,547, evaluator +5,528) to 2,094,214 / 731,897, no budget raised: xquery_lower 30,925, xquery_update_apply 17,391, function_library_xslt 11,083, xquery_update 11,474, xquery_lower_window 10,796, xquery_flwor 8,700, xquery_lower_update 7,899, xslt_read 6,328, the internal data 6,180, xquery_lower_full_text 2,655, function_library_output 1,698, function_library_schema 1,342, function_library_exslt 1,080, the rest under 1,100; 120,332 bytes of code and data in all. sxml-full.wasm 7,044,360 / 1,612,207 to 7,044,334 / 1,612,149; the CLI module 8,636,999 to 8,636,973. Native builds and the full and CLI modules name every language, so they keep every part.
Counts (release, whole runs, 5385a0e against the change): QT4 XP40 32,654 passed and 34 wrong errors, XQ40 45,913 and 55, XT40 11,826 and 173, before and after; no test changed its outcome.

The evaluator step (cd4ac60, at 5664da8): sxml.wasm 2,101,275 / 734,951 to 2,077,439 / 725,473: evaluator_stream 16,118, evaluator_template 4,935, processor 1,074, xml 637 and data (23,739 of code and data). sxml-full.wasm 7,069,158 to 7,069,013, the CLI 8,662,430 to 8,662,285. Release whole runs at 5664da8, before and after: XP40 32,655 and 34 wrong errors, XQ40 45,914 and 55, XT40 11,860 and 163; no outcome changed. The baseline is refreshed from this module.

Rejected: registering a language's parts by hand in its compile entry ('s rejected hand-kept list); a run-time filter of one table by language (the table still links every part); CMake options per module (two builds, ).
